description.text: Climate KIC's climate entrepreneurship is accelerating climate innovation to meet the needs of local climate challenges across the globe.

targetApplicants.text: Realising the full potential of climate solutions requires a concerted global effort, a shift in mindsets, and a stronger focus on demand-driven initiatives. At Climate KIC, we prioritise bridging the gap between the supply of climate innovation and the demand for them, thereby accelerating this change across the globe. Our aim is to transform the start-up support landscape , ensuring that climate action is deeply embedded in the fabric of the entrepreneurial ecosystem.
